Regarding the insider threat analysis, the text describes a high-risk scenario involving the former Research and Development team lead. Several risk factors are present: the individual resigned shortly after several prototypes went missing, they were seen working late unusually often the week before their departure, there were no signs of forced entry suggesting authorized access was used, and the missing items were last known to be in their possession. These factors strongly suggest a potential insider threat involving the theft of intellectual property or proprietary assets by the departing employee.
